description:
Start generating a video from a text prompt with a video model from the Hubris catalogue (Veo, Kling, Seedance, Wan, Hailuo, Runway and others). Same as POST /v1/videos. Generation takes from one to several minutes, so this returns a task id right away; poll video_get with it every 15–30 seconds until status is "completed" or "failed".

Allowed durations, resolutions and aspect ratios differ per model — models_get_pricing lists them under `video`. This tool takes a text prompt only: starting from images or a source video, and models that need a source — video editing, upscaling and talking avatars (FLUX Video Edit, FLUX Video Upscale, Runway Aleph, HeyGen Avatar) — work through the HTTP API (POST /v1/videos).

Connected through OAuth (Claude, Cursor, VS Code)? Video needs the permission to create videos on the consent screen. If this tool answers that videos:write is missing, reconnect.

Spends money from the account balance: priced per second of video. The largest possible cost is held when the task starts, the actual cost is charged when it completes and the difference is returned; a failed generation returns the whole hold.

aspect_ratio.description: Frame shape such as "16:9" or "9:16", from the values the model supports.

duration.description: Length in seconds, from the values the model supports.

generate_audio.description: Generate a soundtrack, on models that can. Usually costs more per second.

idempotency_key.description: Your own unique string for this request. Repeating the call with the same key returns the same task instead of starting and paying for a second one.

model.description: Video model id, vendor included and matched exactly, e.g. "kwaivgi/kling-v3.0-pro". Find one with models_search and tool: "video_create".

prompt.description: What should happen in the video: subject, action, camera, style.

resolution.description: Resolution such as "720p" or "1080p", from the values the model supports.

seed.description: Fixed seed for a repeatable result, on models that support it.

name: video_create
title: Start a video generation
